info.title: CIIR Indexer API
info.description:
Imports CIIR (Code Intelligence Intermediate Representation) JSONL files - produced by the
`code-csharp-ciir` analyzer - into PostgreSQL with pgvector. For each CIIR document, this
service generates an embedding from its precomputed `embeddingText` (reusing the existing
stored vector whenever the text and embedding model are unchanged) and upserts the document,
its relations (e.g. `calls`, `inherits`), and the resolved call/dependency graph.
Re-importing the same file is safe and idempotent: unchanged data is left untouched, and
only a fully successful run removes documents/relations that disappeared from the file.

This service does not parse or analyze source code itself (that is `code-csharp-ciir`'s
job), and it does not implement search, retrieval, reranking, or answer natural-language
questions about the indexed code (that is `code-rag-api`'s job) - its only job is: consume
CIIR documents, generate embeddings, and persist.

Every endpoint accepts and returns `application/json`. Client and server errors are
reported using the RFC 7807 "Problem Details for HTTP APIs" format
(`application/problem+json`), with the exception of 404 responses, which carry no body.

post.summary: Submits a CIIR JSONL file for later indexation.
post.description:
Expects a `multipart/form-data` body with a `projectId` text field naming an
already-registered project, sent before a `ciirFile` file field - `projectId` must
be validated before any byte of the file is stored, so it must arrive first in the stream.
The file is streamed directly into object storage without ever being fully buffered in
memory or on local disk, and is stored under a server-generated random key - never the
client-supplied file name. This endpoint returns as soon as the file is stored, before a
background worker has picked it up. Poll `GET /api/ciir-uploads/{uploadId}` with the id
returned here to observe progress and the final outcome.

projectId.description: An already-registered project's id. Must be sent before 'ciirFile' - it is validated before any byte of the file is stored.

post.summary: Registers a CIIR JSONL file already placed directly in object storage.
post.description:
For files too large to push through `POST /api/ciir-uploads`'s own request body: upload
the `.jsonl` file directly to this service's configured MinIO bucket yourself (e.g. via
`mc cp`), then call this endpoint with the object key you uploaded it under. The
object's existence is verified before registering it, so a typo in `objectKey` fails
immediately rather than leaving a pending upload that can never be processed. From here on,
this behaves exactly like `POST /api/ciir-uploads` - poll
`GET /api/ciir-uploads/{uploadId}` with the id returned here to observe progress.

get.summary: Reports the current status of one CIIR upload.
get.description:
Intended to be polled after `POST /api/ciir-uploads` until `status` reaches a
terminal value (`processed` or `failed`). Once `indexationId` is populated,
`GET /api/indexations/{indexationId}` reports detailed indexation progress and counters.

get.summary: Reports the current status and progress of one indexation.
get.description:
Intended to be polled using the `indexationId` reported by `GET /api/ciir-uploads/{uploadId}`
once that upload starts processing, until `status` reaches a terminal value
(`completed`, `failed`, or `cancelled`). While the run is still in progress
(`pending`, `running`, or `resolving_relations`), the
`documents`/`relations` counters reflect whatever partial progress has been
persisted so far and may still change on the next poll.

Returns a page of projects. Optionally filter the results by project name using a partial,
case-insensitive match. When no project matches the supplied filter (or no projects exist at
all), the response is a 200 OK with an empty items array - this is not treated as an error.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page number to retrieve. Defaults to 0. Must not be negative.

post.description: Creates a new project with the given name, embedding model and embedding dimensions.

get.description: Returns a single project by its id.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description:
Identifier of the project, corresponding to the id field returned by `GET /api/projects`.
Must be a positive 64-bit integer; any other format results in a 400 response.

put.description: Replaces every field of an existing project. This is a full replace (PUT), not a partial patch - every field must be supplied.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description:
Identifier of the project to update, corresponding to the id field returned by
`GET /api/projects`. Must be a positive 64-bit integer; any other format results in a
400 response.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a project. This does not delete the project's indexed CIIR
documents/relations, which remain pointing at a project id that no longer exists.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description:
Identifier of the project to delete, corresponding to the id field returned by
`GET /api/projects`. Must be a positive 64-bit integer; any other format results in a
400 response.

id.description: The upload's id, matching the `uploadId` returned by `POST /api/ciir-uploads`.

projectId.description: The already-registered project this file was submitted for.

status.description:
One of `"pending"`, `"processing"`, `"processed"`, or `"failed"`. Only
`"processed"` and `"failed"` are terminal - stop polling once you observe one of those.

createdAt.description: When the file was received and stored.

processingStartedAt.description: When the worker last claimed this upload; `null` while still `"pending"`.

processedAt.description: When processing reached a terminal outcome; `null` until then.

error.description: A human-readable failure message when Status is `"failed"`; `null` otherwise.

processed.description: Total number of CIIR document records read from the file so far.

inserted.description: Of Processed, how many were brand new (no prior row for that `ciir_id` in this project).

updated.description: Of Processed, how many already existed and were upserted.

embeddingsGenerated.description:
How many documents needed a new embedding call - either newly seen, or their `embeddingText`
changed since the last successful run.

embeddingsReused.description:
How many documents kept their previously stored embedding vector because neither the
`embeddingText` hash nor the embedding model/dimensions changed - no embedding call was made
for these.

processed.description: Total number of relation edges (e.g. `calls`, `inherits`) read from the file so far.

resolved.description:
Of Processed, how many now have their target document linked by foreign key -
these are the edges traversable in the call/dependency graph. Includes both same-project
resolution by `ciir_id` and the symbol-name fallback match.

unresolved.description:
Of Processed, how many CIIR itself classified as
`resolution.status = "unresolved"` - genuinely missing targets, not external references or
dynamic dispatch (those are expected and are not counted here as a problem).

id.description: The indexation run's id, matching the `indexationId` returned by `POST /api/indexations`.

status.description:
One of `"pending"`, `"running"`, `"resolving_relations"`, `"completed"`,
`"failed"`, or `"cancelled"`. Only `"completed"`, `"failed"`, and
`"cancelled"` are terminal - stop polling once you observe one of those.

documents.description: Document import progress and embedding reuse/regeneration counters.

error.description:
A human-readable failure message when Status is `"failed"`; `null`
for every other status.

name.description: Required. The project's name. Must not be empty or blank, and must not already be used by another project (409 otherwise).

embeddingModel.description: Required. The embedding model this project's code documents are (or will be) embedded with. Must not be empty or blank.

embeddingDimensions.description: Required. The dimensionality of that embedding model's vectors. Must be a positive integer.

gitUrl.description: Optional. The project's public git repository URL.

gitRawUrl.description: Optional. The project's public git raw-content URL.

page.description: The zero-based page number this response corresponds to.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items per page.

totalCount.description: The total number of projects matching the filter, across every page.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available for the filter, given PageSize.

ProjectListResponse.description: A single page of a paginated project search, plus the metadata needed to fetch the next one.

name.description: The project's name, unique across every project.

embeddingModel.description: The embedding model this project's code documents are (or will be) embedded with.

embeddingDimensions.description: The dimensionality of that embedding model's vectors.

gitUrl.description: The project's public git repository URL, if any.

gitRawUrl.description: The project's public git raw-content URL, if any.

createdAt.description: When the project was first created.

updatedAt.description: When the project was last updated.

ProjectResponse.description: A project stored by this service, either resolved from an indexation run or managed directly through this CRUD API.

name.description: The project's new name. Must not be empty or blank, and must not already be used by another project (409 otherwise).

embeddingModel.description: The project's new embedding model. Must not be empty or blank.

embeddingDimensions.description: The project's new embedding dimensionality. Must be a positive integer.

gitUrl.description: The project's public git repository URL.

gitRawUrl.description: The project's public git raw-content URL.

ProjectUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/projects/{projectId}`. Full replacement fields for an existing
project - this is a full PUT replace, not a partial patch, so every field must be supplied.

objectKey.description:
Required. The key the `.jsonl` file was already stored under in this service's configured
MinIO bucket - upload it there yourself first (e.g. via `mc cp`), then pass the same key
here.

uploadId.description:
The newly created upload's id. Pass this to `GET /api/ciir-uploads/{uploadId}` to poll for
progress and the final outcome.

status.description: The upload's status immediately after creation. Always `"pending"` at this point.

SubmitCiirUploadResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/ciir-uploads` (upload spec §4).

tags.name: CiirUploads
tags.description: The only way to get a CIIR JSONL file indexed: either CancellationToken) streams it here over HTTP, or CancellationToken) registers one the caller already placed directly in object storage (the bring-your-own-upload path for files too large for a single HTTP request). Both store/confirm the file in object storage for a background worker to pick up later, and this also reports an upload's status. Contains no indexing logic of its own - it delegates all validation to SubmitCiirUpload/RegisterCiirUpload and maps the result to an HTTP response.

tags.name: Indexations
tags.description: Reports the progress of one indexation run. Contains no indexing logic of its own - a run is always created implicitly by the CIIR upload flow (`POST /api/ciir-uploads` or `POST /api/ciir-uploads/register`), never by this controller; this only reads back its status.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Full CRUD over the projects this service owns. Most projects are created/updated implicitly by `POST /api/indexations` and `POST /api/ciir-uploads` (spec's "Atualização — Identidade de projeto informada pelo chamador"), but this controller lets a caller manage them directly - e.g. to register a project before its first indexation, or to update its git metadata without re-running one.
